description: Free. When search_products finds nothing the shopper can buy, leave a standing order for them: exNiche re-checks its retailers daily for 90 days and emails the shopper once when a matching listing appears in their country at or under their price. Use only with the shopper's consent and their own email address; never guess or invent one. The shopper must click the confirmation link exNiche emails them before the order opens. If a matching listing is already on sale, the reply carries it instead (status already_for_sale). Example: {"query": "owala water bottle", "country": "AU", "max_price": 60, "email": "shopper@example.com"}.

email.description: The shopper's own email address, given by them for this alert.

max_price.description: Optional. The most the shopper will pay, in the country's currency (AUD or USD).

query.description: The product in 2 to 5 words, brand first. Every word must appear in a listing's title for it to count.

name: leave_standing_order

status.description: confirmation_sent, confirmation_queued (email delayed, order kept) or already_for_sale

title: Leave a standing order
